**Best move: Rxe6+**

**Main line:** Rxe6+ Kxe6 (or Nxe6+ Kg8 or Rxe6) Re7+ Kd6 (or Kf6/Kxd5) and Black has won the exchange with a winning position.

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching Note:**
The rook on e6 was pinned to White's king—it couldn't move without exposing the king to check. When you spot a pinned piece, look for a way to capture it with check (a fork of king and piece). **Rxe6+** wins the rook immediately because after any king move, your rook is no longer attacked by the pinned piece. Always scan for pinned defenders; they're sitting ducks.
